setBy: Engineering (Claude), Phase 2, 2026-11-08. NOT yet reviewed by the owner.
why: Starting values only. The return-band cut-offs reuse the demo values already used by the clickable prototype and the fixture sanity check. They are product-judgement parameters, NOT research findings and NOT financial advice. The owner must set or confirm every value before Phase 2 is signed off.

flatBandPct.meaning: A% strictly between -value and +value is FLAT

negativeAtOrBelowPct.meaning: A% at or below this is NEGATIVE; between this and -flatBandPct is SMALL_NEGATIVE

positiveAtOrAbovePct.meaning: A% at or above this is POSITIVE; between flatBandPct and this is SMALL_POSITIVE

minInstalmentsForClassification.meaning: Fewer successful instalments than this gives INSUFFICIENT_DATA

shortPeriodXirrBelowMonths.meaning: Tenure below this: XIRR is flagged as annualised from a short period

providerXirrToleranceBps.meaning: |computed - provider| XIRR above this many basis points sets xirrMismatch
